blurb: Boundary Oak Golf Course offers an 18-hole golf course set in the rolling foothills of Mt. Diablo. The facility includes a full pro shop, driving range, restaurant, and practice greens. They provide event hosting for corporate and social events, as well as golf tournaments with full planning support.
